h100-h200-2gpu-tp-eager.description: Hopper 2-GPU TP legacy-compatible FLUX.2 compile profile.
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-eager.notes: Use for SGLang commits before --performance-mode speed existed; TP remains explicit.

blackwell-2gpu-tp-eager.description: Blackwell 2-GPU TP legacy-compatible FLUX.2 compile profile.
blackwell-2gpu-tp-eager.notes: Use for SGLang commits before --performance-mode speed existed; TP remains explicit. Measured on 2xB200 (sglang 0.5.19, ABAB interleaved x4, 2026-09-12): this profile and blackwell-2gpu-tp-speed-eager are indistinguishable -- paired diffs +1.6/+7.6/+1.2/-5.8%, mean +1.15% with mixed signs, against within-arm spreads of 6.6% and 7.9%. So the 'legacy' label is about which flags existed, NOT about speed: --performance-mode speed buys nothing measurable here, and the two profiles are left in this order deliberately. Do not re-run this comparison without a reason; two pairs alone look like a +4.6% win and are noise.

h100-cpu-offload.description: H100 80GB LightX2V FLUX.2 profile: model-granularity CPU offload so the ~64GB bf16 weights fit. Lossless (identical numerics, weights just stream from CPU). Mirrors upstream configs/flux2/flux2_dev_offload.json.
h100-cpu-offload.notes: Measured 2026-07-29 on H100 80GB: single-GPU resident load OOMs at ~78GB used during safetensors read, and the upstream TP path (parallel.tensor_p_size=2, configs/flux2/flux2_dev_tp.json) ALSO fails -- lightx2v loads the full model on rank 0 before sharding ('Single GPU - Load models cost 47.9s' then NCCL init hits cuda OOM), so TP does not reduce peak per-GPU load memory in current main. CPU offload is the only working lossless path on 80GB; expect higher latency than the H200 resident profile by design. rope_type must be the registry key 'flashinfer_rope' (bare 'flashinfer' raises KeyError in current main).

h200-fa3-flashinfer.description: H200 fastest available LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
h200-fa3-flashinfer.notes: Uses FlashAttention 3 with FlashInfer RoPE in the isolated H200 LightX2V venv; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path.

blackwell-fa2-flashinfer.description: Blackwell LightX2V FLUX.2 profile probe using source-built FlashAttention 2 plus FlashInfer RoPE.
blackwell-fa2-flashinfer.notes: Uses a source-built FlashAttention 2 wheel with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0; the upstream FA3 wheel used for H200 is Hopper-only. LightX2V renamed this runner: its registry key is `flux2` (was `flux2_dev`), and the old name fails at worker init with `KeyError: 'flux2_dev'` from runner_factory -- after a full server start, so it reads as a startup failure rather than a bad name. The registry is the authority: `python -c "from lightx2v.models.runners.runner_factory import RUNNER_MODULES; print(sorted(RUNNER_MODULES))"`. The runner also requires `model_variant`: LightX2V split the old flux2_dev runner into `flux2` + model_variant dev|klein, and an absent variant fails at worker init with `ValueError: Unsupported Flux2 model_variant: None` -- a second layer behind the KeyError, each one only visible after the previous is fixed.

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official 'Text to Image (Flux.2 Dev)' blueprint with the bf16 DiT from BFL's own repo in place of flux2_dev_fp8mixed, and the full FLUX.2 VAE in place of the blueprint's small-decoder variant (a different decoder). Guidance-distilled: FluxGuidance + BasicGuider, no CFG. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile on: the core TorchCompileModel node (inductor) goes behind every diffusion-model loader, as the other competitors run compile-on; measured on FLUX.1 / 1xB200 2026-09-25 at 4.89s against 5.94s and 5.77s eager.

blackwell-gpuonly.description: Blackwell: the default graph with every model resident on the GPU (--gpu-only).
blackwell-gpuonly.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.
